messages: My father suddenly has chest pain and he is sweating and cannot breathe well
My baby is 3 weeks old, her body is very hot and she will not breastfeed at all||It started last night, she is just lying there quietly
My grandmother suddenly cannot move her right arm and her speech is not clear||It started about one hour ago
A snake bit my brother on the farm just now||His leg is swelling fast and he feels dizzy
My son fell from a tree and now he keeps vomiting and wants to sleep||He is 8 years old, it happened this afternoon
My daughter has had a fever since yesterday||She is 3 years old||No vomiting and she is drinking water
I have been coughing for over a week now||No blood when I cough, but I feel weak and sometimes hot at night
My son has diarrhoea with some blood in it since yesterday||He is 4 years old and he is drinking ORS
My ear has been paining me for two days and now something like pus is coming out||I am 25, no fever
I have a slight headache after working in the sun all day||No fever and I feel okay otherwise. It started this afternoon
I have a runny nose and I am sneezing since this morning||No fever, I can eat and work normally
My daughter scraped her knee playing football||It is a small scratch, it stopped quickly and she is playing again
I feel tired and my body aches a little after farm work||It started today, no fever, I am eating well

ina tari tun mako guda||babu jini, amma ina jin rauni da zafi da dare

ina jin ciwon kai kadan bayan aiki a rana||babu zazzabi kuma ina shan ruwa
ina da mura da atishawa tun safe||babu zazzabi, ina iya aiki da cin abinci
